high_level_description: stc brand style, a dramatic rocket launch photograph against a purple and orange gradient sky.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A sky transitioning from deep purple at the top to warm orange near the horizon, creating a striking color gradient.

elements.desc: A rocket ascending vertically in the center of the frame, trailing a bright white exhaust and flame with a subtle blue-white glow and lens flare at the top.
